stored.zip: Four stored members; two synthesized parent directories
deflated.zip: Real raw-deflate payload produced by zipfile
deflated-directory.zip: Legal empty directory has two compressed deflate bytes and zero uncompressed bytes
implicit-directory.zip: Parent directory exists implicitly without timestamp or compression metadata
utf8.zip: UTF-8 flag; Chinese paths, supplementary emoji, and decomposed accent normalized to NFC
cp437.zip: CP437 byte 0x82 is e acute, without UTF-8 flag

unicode-stale.zip: Stale Unicode path filename CRC is ignored; legacy name remains authoritative
unicode-unsafe-alias.zip: Unsafe Unicode alias cannot bypass path validation
unicode-unsafe-raw.zip: Safe Unicode alias cannot conceal unsafe legacy name
unicode-invalid.zip: Matching Unicode path field contains invalid UTF-8
unicode-duplicate.zip: Repeated Unicode path fields are ambiguous
unicode-utf8-disagreement.zip: Flagged UTF-8 raw name disagrees with Unicode path extra
unicode-local-disagreement.zip: Local and central effective Unicode paths disagree
unicode-local-type-disagreement.zip: Local-only Unicode alias adds directory slash; normalized name matches central file but kind conflicts
descriptor.zip: Non-seekable zipfile writer emits signed data descriptor
descriptor-bad-crc.zip: Descriptor CRC disagrees with central directory

signature.jar: ZIP signature accepted with JAR extension
signature.data: ZIP signature accepted without ZIP extension
nested.zip: Nested archive remains an ordinary member; no recursive payload parsing
compare-left.zip: Comparison fixture left: presence, kind, size, CRC, time
compare-right.zip: Comparison fixture right: all supported difference states

strong-encrypted.zip: Encrypted flag set in both headers; unsupported
zip64-extra.zip: ZIP64 extra field with ZIP32-sized member

corrupt-local-flags.zip: Local header disagrees with central header: local-flags
corrupt-local-crc.zip: Local header disagrees with central header: local-crc
corrupt-local-size.zip: Local header disagrees with central header: local-size
corrupt-local-compressed-size.zip: Local header disagrees with central header: local-compressed-size

corrupt-local-name.zip: Local and central raw filenames disagree
corrupt-local-offset.zip: Local offset points into central directory
corrupt-overlap.zip: First payload extent overlaps the second local header
corrupt-directory-size.zip: Directory entry claims nonzero stored payload
corrupt-stored-size.zip: Stored size and uncompressed size disagree
corrupt-count.zip: EOCD member count exceeds central records
